dedupe_keys.name: instituto canario de estadistica istac inland waterway datasets

description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): inland waterway datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about inland waterway; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Clasificación de los canales de información (ISTAC: CL_ENCUESTAS_CANAL; Estancia media según canales de venta de los vuelos. Canarias y period; Estancia media según canales de venta de los vuelos. Islas de Canarias; Estancia media según canales de venta de los vuelos. Islas por periodo. Formats seen: JSON, CSV, PC-AXIS, SHEET, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
